items.headline: Manchester United beat Rosenborg 5-0 in preseason friendly
items.summary: United won 5-0 against Rosenborg in Trondheim, Norway on July 25. Joshua Zirkzee scored a notable individual goal. Squad including Leny Yoro, Bryan Mbeumo, Andrey Santos.

items.headline: Joshua Zirkzee future uncertain amid Italian club interest
items.summary: Zirkzee could move after failing to perform to required standard in two seasons. Italian clubs interested. Scored against Rosenborg but remains potential departure candidate.

items.headline: Benjamin Sesko continues injury recovery, expected fit for Premier League
items.summary: Sesko unavailable for preseason after shin injury from final stretch of last season. Expected to be fully fit for Premier League campaign start.
